adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6`, `basePath(store, type)` was changed to `type.replace('_', '-')` before checking `ADMIN_MODELS`. In JS, `String#replace` without a global regex only replaces the first underscore, so a type name with multiple underscores would be partially converted (e.g. `foo_bar_baz` -> `foo-bar_baz`) and could fail to match a dashed entry in `ADMIN_MODELS`. The finding’s broader scenario about “sideload-hydrated admin type with two underscores in its `*_ids` key” causing a runtime 404 is speculative/not directly shown by this diff, but the brittleness of the new `replace` logic itself is real and diff-grounded.
